newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Wednesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 100 head slaughter heifers; 88,000 head confirmed for the week to date, which includes 27,100 head formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink. Slaughter Heifers - Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1150 lbs 64.00.
Confirmed - 100 Week Ago - Holiday Year Ago - 900
Wk to Date - 88,000 Week Ago - 18,500 Year Ago - 16,600
